Emily will be at Financial District from 11:30AM to 9:45PM. You'd like to meet Emily for a minimum of 105 minutes.

{"itinerary": [{"action": "meet", "person": "<PERSON_NAME>", "start_time": "<HH:MM>", "end_time": "<HH:MM>"}]}. Make sure to include the person's name for each meeting.

3. Travel to Haight-Ashbury (7 minutes) to meet Kevin. Arrive at 10:17 AM. Meet Kevin from 10:17 AM to 11:47 AM (90 minutes).
4. Travel to Financial District (21 minutes) to meet Emily. Arrive at 12:08 PM. Meet Emily from 12:08 PM to 1:53 PM (105 minutes).
5. Travel to Presidio (22 minutes) to meet Stephanie. Arrive at 2:15 PM. Meet Stephanie from 2:15 PM to 4:15 PM (120 minutes).
6. Travel to Bayview (31 minutes) to meet Deborah. Arrive at 4:46 PM. Meet Deborah from 4:46 PM to 6:46 PM (120 minutes).
